Commentary.Commentary: That's it from this game. A see-saw match but the hosts fought back and now have a chance to whitewash Pakistan when they will face them on the 19th of January 2018 in Wellington at 1100 local (2200 GMT). Should be a good game as Pakistan will want to go into the T20Is with some momentum. Do join us for all the action. You can now switch your tabs to catch all the updates from the game between South Africa and India. Cheers!

Pakistan captain, Sarfraz Ahmed says that it was a very disappointing loss for them but they had positives to take from this game as Fakhar Zaman, Haris Sohail and Mohammad Hafeez batted really well. Mentions that it was a good total on the board and he had confidence in his bowlers to defend it. On being asked about de Grandhomme's innings, he answers that Colin played a really great knock and some big strikes from him helped them win the match.

New Zealand captain, Kane Williamson walks in for an interview. About the game, he says it was a good one and Pakistan played well. Adds that they didn't lose early wickets but lost quite a few in the middle overs. Continues saying that Colin de Grandhomme played well and it was a special innings from him. Informs that they practice playing spin during the net session but it was different today. Gives credit to the top order for providing them with a good start. Praises Henry Nicholls for his contribution. Ends by saying that it feels nice to win the game as they were under pressure.

Colin de Grandhomme bags the Man of the Match award for his quickfire 74 runs off 40 balls. On being asked, how did he feel going out in the middle, he replies that he was hitting it well and got underneath the ball to clear it away. He mentions it was important to build a partnership with Henry Nicholls and take it to the very end which they eventually managed.

Pakistan played a lot better today but still suffered the same fate. It was a case of one man playing an extraordinary knock to take away the game from them. Shadab Khan was the star performer for the visitors but apart from him, their bowling lacked discipline and consistency. With just one game left, they will have to better their overall performance to avoid the whitewash.

The Kiwi skipper was dismissed in the 35th over and New Zealand needed 109 runs more for a win. But Pakistan's hope of capitalizing from thereon was punctured by Colin de Grandhomme's blitzkrieg. His whirlwind 40-ball 74 knock included 12 brutal boundaries and the tourists just surrendered in front of his might. Henry Nicholls also anchored the innings well and was a quiet contributor in a couple of crucial stands.

New Zealand got off to a flying start chasing a target of 263. Colin Munro was in his elements and along with Martin Guptill laid a solid platform up front. Just when it seemed that the match is done and dusted, Pakistan made a resounding comeback. Shadab Khan was in the thick of things as he forced a collapse. From 0 for 88, New Zealand slipped to 4 for 99 and were staring down the barrel when Kane Williamson got together with Henry Nicholls to thread a 55-run stand.

All over in a flash! Pakistan will be shell-shocked at the moment! They were dominating the game and after dismissing Kane Williamson had the upper hand. But then, a tsunami named Colin de Grandhomme struck them! The big all-rounder grabbed the game by the scruff of the neck and powered New Zealand to 4-0!

New Zealand seal a 5-wicket victory! Nicholls pulls this one behind square leg for the winning run. They go 4-0 up in the 5-match series. The hosts have now beaten Pakistan in 10 consecutive ODIs. Their dominance prevails as they bag yet another comfortable victory.

FOUR! Full and outside off by Amir, Munro hits it with some aggression past the left side of the mid off fielder for a boundary.
A good length delivery outside off, Munro pushes it to the cover region.
Amir bowls a full delivery outside off, Munro defends it off the front foot.
Guptill pushes it to the cover region.
Ali bangs it short on middle. Guptill goes for the pull but is late onto it. He toe edges it to the mid on fielder.
FOUR! Cut and cut hard. Ali gave him the option to free his arms and Guptill accepted the gift with both hands. A short delivery outside off, Guptill gets it past the point fielder for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery punched by Guptill off the back foot towards the cover region.
Guptill defends a back of a length delivery towards the off side.
Ali bowls a full one outside off, Guptill times the drive beautifully but straight into the cover fielder's hands.
Guptill tucks it off his legs towards the square leg region and keeps the strike for next over.
Guptill stands tall to a back of a length delivery and plays it to the point fielder.
Guptill punches the ball off the back foot towards the cover region.
Guptill tucks a back of a length delivery towards square leg.

Amir bowls a full pitched delivery outside off, Guptill tries to loft it over the mid off region but only slices it towards the sweeper cover area for a brace. That was in the air for some time but safe.
Back of a length delivery angling towards the batsman, Guptill rocks on the back foot and defends it.
FOUR! Short, wide and asking to be put away. Ali dragged it short outside off, Munro cuts hard towards the left of the point fielder for a boundary. That shot looked pleasing to the eye.
A full delivery is driven towards the mid on area.
Munro opens the face of the bat and guides the ball towards the point fielder.
Munro pushes the ball towards the mid off area off the back foot.

Ali bowls a back of a length delivery on the stumps, Munro tries to clip it towards the leg side but misses it. It hits him on his thigh pad and Ali goes up for the appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Good length delivery outside off, Munro defends it off the front foot towards the cover-point region.
Again a short pitched delivery on the stumps, Guptill punches it to the cover fielder. A maiden over by Amir.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Guptill punches it off the back foot towards the off side.
Quick by Amir! A bouncer to surprise Guptill. He does really well to duck that one out.
Full pitched delivery on the stumps, Guptill drives it to mid on.
Amir shortens his length and Guptill defends it off the back foot.
Amir bowls a back of a length delivery outside off, Guptill lets this one go.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Munro. Back of a length delivery outside off, Munro punches it off the back foot through the cover area for a boundary. Good end to the over for the home side.
FOUR! Good strike by Munro. Length delivery on the stumps, Munro picks it up and heaves it to the square leg region. The ball rushes into the fence for a boundary. He made that look very easy.
Full delivery outside off is driven to mid off by Munro.
Munro defends it off the back foot.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Guptill defends it off the back foot towards the point region. The batsmen come through for a single.

Ali starts up with bowling it full outside off, Guptill drives it past the point fielder for a brace. The point fielder manages to get some hand to it or else it would have been the first boundary of the innings.
Hasan Ali will bowl from other end.
Guptill cuts it to the point region and he will keep the strike for the next over.
Dragged it short and wide, Munro goes for the cut but finds the outside edge fly towards the third man region. It was in the air for some time but safe. The batsmen change ends.
Amir follows it up by bowling it full and quick on the stumps, Munro defends it off the front foot.
Amir bangs it short, Guptill hangs back and plays it towards the off side to open the account for his team.
Amir pitches it on a driving length outside off, Guptill shoulders arms to this one.
Good seam up delivery to start with. Pitches it on a good length area outside off, Guptill lets this one go to the keeper.
The umpires make their way out in the middle. Martin Guptill and Colin Munro will open the innings for the Black Caps. Mohammad Amir will start the proceedings for Pakistan. Here we go...
